05:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: NFL Matchup
Sal Paolantonio, Matt Bowen and Greg Cosell bring viewers inside the film room for the X's and O's analysis of the weekend's NFL matchups.

05:30 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: College Football
The Tennessee Volunteers host the Kentucky Wildcats in a regular-season college football game. Tennessee has 39 quarterback hits to defend home turf after five straight rivalry wins, while Kentucky leans on a one-interception record over eight games.
